title: Without Create & Edit, create/edit options are hidden on work orders
preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View only.
steps:
1. Log in and open the work order list.
  2. Look for any New work order/Create button.
  3. Open a work order and try to edit a header field.
expected:
There is no create button.

The work order header fields are read-only.
